raw_segments.text: He went upon the stage, and took his place beside the rest who were to compose the base
They all stretched themselves on the floor, their noses pointing to the ceiling.
A second group of artists disposed themselves on these long appendages, then a third above
these, then a fourth, until a human monument reaching to the very cornices of the theater
soon arose on top of the noses.
This elicited loud applause, in the midst of which the orchestra was just striking up
When the pyramid tottered, the balance was lost.
One of the lower noses vanished from the pyramid, and the human monument was shattered
like a castle built of cards.
